name: Special Joint City Council/Planning Commission Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Joint City Council/Planning Commission Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 11, 2015 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
SPECIAL PRESENTATION/PROCLAMATIONS
Presentation of proclamation to the California Native Plant Society - San Diego proclaiming Native Plant Week.
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
At Home in Encinitas. The purpose of this joint study session of the City Council and the Planning Commission is to: 1) Review the draft modifications proposed to the City's Housing Element document; and, 2) direct that the conceptual draft document be analyzed in the Environmental Impact Report (EIR).
1) Receive the draft changes to the draft Housing Element; 2) Receive and consider public testimony; 3) Direct any changes/modifications to the draft Housing Element; 4) Direct that the conceptual Housing Element be analyzed in the Environmental Impact Report (EIR); and, 5) Authorize staff to submit the conceptual Housing Element (with conceptual housing strategy sites) to the Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) for Substantial Compliance Determination.
2015-03-11 Item 01 - Housing Element Agenda Report and Attachment A
2015-03-11 Item 01 - Attachment B
2015-03-11 Item 01 - Attachment C
2015-03-11 Item 01 - Attachment D Part 1
2015-03-11 Item 01 - Attachment D Part 2 (Please Note: This attachment may take a minute to load)
2015-03-11 Item 01 - Attachment E & F
2.
At Home in Encinitas: Award of Contract to RECON in the amount of $299,860 for the preparation of an Environmental Impact Report (EIR) for the Housing Element Update. This item was moved from the February 25, 2015 City Council meeting.
Award the contract for the reasons specified in the Agenda Report and authorize the City Manager to execute the same.
2015-03-11 Item 02 - RECON EIR Contract
3.
An alternative land use plan/map to be considered by the Council for inclusion in the City's Housing Element Update Environmental Impact Report (EIR). Presented by the Community Based Housing Map Group/Encinitas Taxpayers Association.
Receive presentation and provide direction to staff.
2015-03-11 Item 03 - Community Based Housing Map Group
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
